findings.evidence: Radiative.lean:260-264; goal is `(sigmaMethod g e.k e.p e.kPrime e.pX).y = (e.trueInvariants g .initialState).y` while the term's type is `SigmaMethodData.ySigma ⟨e.pX, e.kPrime, e.p⟩ g = (e.hardKinematics .initialState).yInel g`. `leptonOut_initialState` (Radiative.lean:151) and `hardKinematics_kPrime` (`@[simps]`, Radiative.lean:173) both exist but are unused.
findings.fix: Prove it in tactic mode: `rw [sigmaMethod_y, trueInvariants_y]` and supply the arguments with `leptonOut_initialState` / `hardKinematics_k` rewritten explicitly (e.g. `(e.hardKinematics_kPrime _).trans (leptonOut_initialState e)`), so the proof does not depend on how `sigmaMethod`, `trueInvariants`, `hardKinematics`, `leptonIn`/`leptonOut` happen to be written.
findings.issue: `sigmaMethod_y_eq_trueInvariants_y_initialState` is a bare application of `SigmaMethodData.ySigma_eq_yInel` that elaborates only up to defeq in four places: the goal's LHS needs `sigmaMethod_y`, its RHS needs `trueInvariants_y`, the `hk'` argument `e.hardKinematics_kPrime _` has type `… = e.leptonOut .initialState` and must silently reduce to `e.kPrime` (`leptonOut_initialState`), and `p_add_leptonIn_initialState_eq_pX_add_kPrime` must match `d.targetMomentum + K.k` via `hardKinematics_k`. None of this is visible or documented, and every one of those lemmas is generated by this PR.

findings.evidence: Radiative.lean:302-308, 326-334, 343-349 all repeat `ext` with `congrArg ReconstructedInvariants.{x,Q2,y} hK`; `TrueInvariants.toReconstructedInvariants` (AccessMethods.lean:299) is literally the three projections, so the shared fact is a one-line `rfl`-lemma.
findings.fix: Add that one lemma next to `trueInvariants` and rewrite with it; `electronMethod_eq_trueInvariants_of_photon_eq_zero` then becomes `rw [trueInvariants_toReconstructedInvariants]; exact hK`, and the Sigma/mixed proofs drop their `congrArg` bullets.
findings.issue: The three Born-limit proofs (`electronMethod_eq_trueInvariants_of_photon_eq_zero` 297-308, `sigmaMethod_…` 317-334, `mixedMethod_…` 337-349) each repeat the same `ext` + per-field `congrArg ReconstructedInvariants.x/Q2/y` destructuring of a `⟨xBj, Q2, yInel⟩`-shaped equation, with the goal closed only by iota-reducing a projection applied to an anonymous constructor. The reusable fact — that `(e.trueInvariants g l).toReconstructedInvariants = ⟨(e.hardKinematics l).xBj g, (e.hardKinematics l).Q2 g, (e.hardKinematics l).yInel g⟩` — is never stated.

summary: Proofs are mostly short and use robust automation, but one key term-mode proof typechecks only through several undocumented definitional unfoldings even though the PR itself generates the corresponding `@[simps]` lemmas, and the three Born-limit proofs repeat the same projection boilerplate instead of factoring one lemma.
